#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int n, mod, offset;
vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp;

int dpf(int done, int i, int diff) {
    if (i == n)
        return diff > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    if (dp[done][i][diff + offset] != -1)
        return dp[done][i][diff + offset];
    int rem = n - i;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int l = 0; l < rem; l++) {
        int rstart = (done == 1) ? 0 : l;
        for (int r = rstart; r < rem; r++) {
            ans += dpf(done | (l < r ? 1 : 0), i + 1, diff + l - r);
            if (ans >= mod) ans -= mod;
        }
    }
    dp[done][i][diff + offset] = ans;
    return ans;
}

long long dp2(int i) {
    if (i == n - 1)
        return 0;
    long long ans = (n - i) * 1LL * dp2(i + 1) % mod;
    for (int l = 0; l < n - i; l++) {
        for (int r = l + 1; r < n - i; r++) {
            ans += dpf(1, i + 1, l - r);
            ans %= mod;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> mod;
    offset = n * (n - 1);
    dp.assign(2, vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(2 * offset + 1, -1)));
    cout << dp2(0) << endl;
    return 0;
}
